description: Family logistics. Two requests owe a stored fact (Maya's nut allergy for the party order, the school's pick-up change) beside a look-alike (a cousin's allergy note, another school's notice); the rest are errands that share names and words with stored items without depending on them.

docs.title: Maya's allergy plan
docs.text: Maya is allergic to peanuts and tree nuts; she must not have anything made in a nut kitchen.

docs.title: Re: Sam's visit
docs.text: Sam (your cousin's boy) can't have dairy, but nuts are fine for him.

docs.title: Oakfield Primary: early finish
docs.text: School finishes at 13:30 on Friday 13 November; pick-up must be from the side gate.

docs.title: St Mary's newsletter

docs.title: Maya's swimming lessons
docs.text: Lessons are on Saturdays at 10:00; parents must wait in the gallery.
